title: Add scheduled backups

context.summary: Add scheduled backup execution under MINDORY_HOME.
context.background: Manual backup exists; public self-host users also need configured schedules, retention and health.

in: Add scheduled backup configuration to installer and config catalog.
Implement a lock-protected backup runner under MINDORY_HOME.
Add retention policy, logs and health status.
Add restore smoke validation for scheduled backup outputs.
Remove TASK-103-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.

acceptance_criteria: Scheduled backups can be enabled and disabled through config.
Only one scheduled backup run executes at a time.
Retention deletes expired backup sets safely.
Health status reports last success, last failure and next run.

manual_checks: Confirm schedule state lives under MINDORY_HOME.

risks: Retention logic must never delete the active runtime data directories.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
